_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or derived from extracted values by a rule stated beside it.

fee_dollars.basis: dollars added to Texans' auto insurance by the 2023 law

fee_year.basis: year the Legislature passed the fee

fee_to_flock_m_min.basis: millions of dollars of the fee put toward the Flock network, at least

cameras_funded_min.basis: Flock cameras the authority turned the fee into, at least

searches_2025.basis: searches of the authority's plate reader data in 2025, as the authority reported

cleared_cases.basis: cleared catalytic converter theft cases, about, as the authority reported

tollway_cameras.basis: more cameras the authority approved money for DPS to install along tollways

jurisdictions_off_min.basis: cities and counties that shut off Flock cameras since the funding was rescinded, at least

cameras_off_min.basis: Flock cameras shut off since the funding was rescinded, more than

laredo_cost_m.basis: millions of dollars a year the Laredo referendum asks about

laredo_cameras.basis: Laredo cameras the referendum asks about

kyle_cameras.basis: Kyle cameras the grant share would help pay for

el_paso_days.basis: days El Paso's council gave the city manager to remove the cameras

deflock_estimate.basis: a watchdog's estimate of all Flock cameras in Texas, late August

laredo_votes_cast.basis: votes cast on Laredo's referendum call, yes plus no, drawn as dais chairs and never printed

tribune_jurisdictions_named_off.basis: count of governments c5 names as ending contracts (Plano, Robinson, Kendall County), counted from the quote's list
tribune_jurisdictions_named_off.rule: len(['Plano','Robinson','Kendall County']) checked against the quote below
